tool_input.description: Replace record struct with tuple, format, and rebuild

result:
`Set.prototype.union` is implemented in `crates/kahvi-builtins/src/set/prototype_union.rs`, the only file changed. Clippy is clean, and 24 of the 58 union runs pass; the other 34 fail only with not-implemented errors from missing dependencies (`Set.prototype.size`, `SetIteratorPrototype.next`, `Set.prototype.delete`, `Map.prototype.size`), so the ticket's "all pass" condition can't be met yet.

I added `GetSetRecord` as a local helper in this file, since the other Set methods will need it too; it returns a tuple rather than a struct, because unused struct fields trip dead-code and I can't add an `#[allow]`. The result object is created before the copy of `[[SetData]]` so it stays rooted during `next()`; that step is out of spec order but unobservable.

BLOCKED: `Set.prototype.size` getter, `SetIteratorPrototype.next`, `Set.prototype.delete` and `Map.prototype.size` getter are not implemented (needed by the union tests' setup and iteration).
